_doc: Region recipe: Canopy Fold (Cigarra's homeland). Data only; the runtime (Agent 2) reads it. Schema: design/DATA_REQUESTS.md. Source: bible Book VI section 22. Event 'when' and choice 'requires' use the Ledger spec DSL; choice 'records' are Ledger.record() calls.
name: The Canopy Fold
summary: A vertical continental ecology. Sunlit crowns above, green twilight below, deep settlements that never see sky. Routes are living bridges that grow, die and migrate, so every map is temporary.

surfaces.desc: A grown span of braided roots; flexes underfoot and creaks.
A thick limb carpeted in damp moss.
Overlapping ridges of old trunk bark, good traction.
Deep fallen-leaf drifts in the lower layers.

ground.relief: vertical; ramps are boughs and spiral trunks, drops are real

props.note: The central traversal prop. Sags under weight; regrows.
A hollow trunk with strung fibers; Listeners study vibration here.
Cigarra's people hang small objects as cognitive anchors.
Route blockers; routes change when limbs fall.

flora: broadleaf crown, ringed fern, thread-moss, lantern bracket fungus, pale orchid sprays

creatures.name: Thread Hopper
creatures.desc: Palm-sized hoppers that leap along silk guy-lines between boughs.
creatures.behavior: Flees upward when frightened. Their droppings feed the moss that stabilizes bridges.

creatures.name: Veil Skimmer
creatures.desc: Translucent gliders that drift between layers.
creatures.behavior: Passive. Gliding paths reveal safe airflow to those who watch.

creatures.name: Bough Stalker
creatures.desc: Long-limbed predator that waits motionless on a limb.
creatures.behavior: Ambushes from above. Hesitates if the target moves unpredictably.

creatures.name: Root Weaver
creatures.desc: A slow, many-legged builder that braids roots into new spans.
creatures.behavior: Ignores everything while it weaves. Harming it halts bridge growth.

music.mood: suspended, curious, a little too busy
music.stinger_on_event: a single high note that answers itself

encounters.ambient: listening houses tapping; distant bridge creak

world_states.label: Overgrowth
world_states.effect: New bridges everywhere, half of them wrong. Routes reshuffle each Descent; more roots block paths.

world_states.label: Migration
world_states.effect: Hopper herds cross in waves. Bridges are crowded; encounters shift toward ambush predators.

world_states.label: Extraction
world_states.effect: Dominion survey rigs bore into trunks. Drones patrol the mid layer.

bondable_here.hook: Her homeland. Listeners can tell the Handler how her Knack began.
Evacuation practice: sagging bridges are the best teachers.

descent_events.title: A bridge that was not there yesterday
descent_events.text: A span of braided root crosses a drop that was empty on the last survey. It flexes when you step near it. The root weavers are still working on the far end.

choices.label: Test the span, one step at a time.
choices.result: It holds. You mark it for the others, and Cigarra marks it twice, just in case.

choices.label: Cross at a run.
choices.result: It sways, then settles. A root weaver stops weaving and watches you go.

choices.label: Wait until the weaver finishes.
choices.result: The bridge is stronger by morning. The route is also longer.

descent_events.title: Hopper wave
descent_events.text: Thread Hoppers pour across the nearest bough in their hundreds, along guy-lines that sing as they go. A Dominion lamp rig hangs ahead and its light is scattering them.

choices.label: Shut the lamp rig off.
choices.result: The hoppers regroup and cross in order. The Dominion log will list a fault.

choices.label: Hold the bridge steady while they cross.
choices.result: Aruun braces the span with Morrow. Every hopper crosses.

choices.label: Clear them off with force.
choices.result: They scatter into the dark. Some will not find their guy-lines.

descent_events.title: Dominion survey convoy
descent_events.text: A convoy of survey sleds rides a reinforced bough with a trunk-boring rig mounted on the lead sled. A Survey Chief waves a permit at the Gate pad's transponder.

choices.label: Log the rig as unpermitted and photograph the bore.
choices.result: The evidence is clean. Mara will have something to file.

choices.label: Offer terms: a bypass for a pause in boring.
choices.result: The chief takes the deal. The trunk lives another season.

choices.label: Disable the rig by force.
choices.result: The rig is down. The drones are not pleased.

choices.label: Pull the survey crew off the sagging bough before it drops them.
choices.result: The crew climbs down on your line. The chief says nothing, which for a chief is thanks.

choices.label: Let the survey run. Take the sample data.
choices.result: The data is excellent. The trunk is not.

descent_events.title: A treehopper alone on a snapped limb
descent_events.text: A young treehopper, crown not yet branched, clings to a limb that has snapped halfway. It buzzes in a pattern you almost recognize.

choices.label: Carry it down to the next bough.
choices.result: It does not thank you. It hops once on your shoulder before it leaves.

choices.label: Scan it first.
choices.result: The scan frightens it. It jumps. The scan data is good.

choices.label: Leave it. The limb is not your concern.
choices.result: The limb holds. You will never know.

descent_events.title: A marker stone in the moss
descent_events.text: A stone marker stands in the moss at the foot of a trunk. The symbols on it match a marker you saw in the Red Reaches, continents away. Nobody here knows what it says.

choices.label: Read it with Cigarra.
choices.result: She finds a pattern: it describes a route by its probability of safe passage. The Fold has old words too.

choices.label: Copy it and move on.
choices.result: The copy is faithful. The stone is just a stone now.

descent_events.title: The Listening House
descent_events.text: A Listener asks you to sit still for the length of three breaths. 'Tell me what you hear,' she says. She is not testing your ears.

choices.label: Sit and listen.
choices.result: You hear a bridge tighten three boughs away. The Listener nods. 'Not everyone hears that.'

choices.label: Ask Cigarra to look ahead, and pay the cost.
choices.result: She sees a falling limb. You step out of its way. It lands where she said it would.

choices.label: Ignore the vision. Take the other path anyway.
choices.result: The limb does not fall. Cigarra says nothing, and she is quietly delighted.

descent_events.title: Bridge failure
descent_events.text: The mid bridge sags, then shears at the far anchor. A line of Canopy travelers is halfway across with no way back.

choices.label: Run the evacuation. Find the second exit first.
choices.result: Bramvex counts the exits out loud and finds a hollow trunk that leads down. Everyone gets out.

choices.label: Brace the span and hold it.
choices.result: Aruun redistributes the load. It is not graceful. It works.

choices.label: Cross first and haul people over after.
choices.result: Two travelers are lost before you finish the haul.

choices.label: Let it fall. It is not your bridge.
choices.result: It falls. The travelers fall with it.

descent_events.title: The squad that did not make it
descent_events.text: A quiet, narrow limb. The place where you lost someone last time. Bramvex stops walking.

choices.label: Sit with the squad and walk through what happened, step by step.
choices.result: Nobody speaks for a while. Then Bramvex starts counting, and the rest of the squad starts to answer.

story.title: The Map That Won't Hold
story.logline: Living bridges are dying faster than anyone can map them, and Cigarra is asked to decide which future to trust.

acts.title: Ghost Routes
acts.beat: A living bridge Cigarra crossed last week is already gone, and the survey convoy lists it as 'permanent'. Premonition shows three routes blinking out together. Every settlement on the high boughs is about to be cut off.

acts.title: Certainty Is a Rope
acts.beat: The Listening House asks Cigarra to name which of its futures should be built toward. Every elder wants a single answer. She sees nine and trusts none of them, and the cable crews are waiting for a decision they can bolt to a tree.

acts.title: The Long Bough
acts.beat: The great Long Bough, the one bridge every route depends on, begins its slow migration. It will cross the Fold in one night and then close forever behind it. Whatever Cigarra has taught the Fold about uncertainty, or failed to, will decide who is on it.

variants.text: Cigarra steps off the predicted path and finds the one future she did not see: a narrow bough that nobody mapped. Everyone crosses. She laughs for the first time in weeks.
She picks one vision and commits. It costs a settlement its roost, and saves the rest. She will not be sure it was right, but she will be sure she decided.
The bridge folds half a minute early, and the crossing becomes a shouted, improvised relay of ropes and hopper leaps. Nobody is lost. Nobody could explain how.

side_quests.title: The Lantern Census
side_quests.summary: A deep settlement's glow-fungus shelves are dying one by one and nobody can tell which will go next. Without them, the lower halls go dark.

choices.label: Use Premonition to see which shelves will fail first.
choices.result: The ghosts show it clearly. Three shelves, in order. It costs you a headache and a tin of tea.
choices.consequence: The keepers move cuttings in time. Ottoline writes your method into the hall ledger.

choices.label: Do it by feel, with cuttings and plain guessing.
choices.result: You lose one shelf. You save two. Ottoline calls it an acceptable error.
choices.consequence: The hall learns the shelves can be tended without prophecy.

choices.label: Accept Dominion lamps and leave the fungus alone.
choices.result: The hall is lit by morning. It is also brighter than anyone remembers.
choices.consequence: The fungus shelves go dormant, and the hall pays for the lamps.

side_quests.title: Maren's Bridge
side_quests.summary: A living bridge Maren's family has trained for four generations is dying. Her grandchildren cross it every day. Premonition shows the bridge failing in two ways.

choices.label: Graft a young vine in and nurse it for days.
choices.result: It is slow and dull. By the third day, the bridge flexes the way a living thing should.
choices.consequence: The bridge lives another generation, and so does the lesson.

choices.label: Look past both futures and cut a different crossing.
choices.result: Maren sighs. 'That is not on any map.' 'No,' you say, 'that is why it works.'
choices.consequence: A new crossing goes in where no one predicted, and stays.

choices.label: Trust the more certain vision, and cut the bridge early.
choices.result: It falls on schedule. Maren's grandchildren are safe, and she does not speak to you for a week.
choices.consequence: The Quill family learns to cross at the new place. It is not the same.

side_quests.title: Permanent Cable
side_quests.summary: Wren is stringing steel cable through the Fold to make routes permanent for convoys. The trees will not survive the tension.

choices.label: Help her string it, and mark the weakest trees.
choices.result: The convoy routes are fast. The marked trees fall by autumn.
choices.consequence: The Fold gets straighter and poorer.

choices.label: Document the damage and send it to the Stewardship Coalition.
choices.result: Wren is furious for an afternoon, and then, quietly, relieved.
choices.consequence: The permit is suspended, and Wren is reassigned to a desk she hates.

choices.label: Offer her living-bridge routes that carry the same weight.
choices.result: She walks them twice and then admits, grudgingly, that they are better.
choices.consequence: Convoys use growing bridges. Wren starts learning how to read them.

side_quests.title: The Charm Line Thief
side_quests.summary: Somebody has been taking small charms from the hanging lines at the crown. The charms are wishes. Their owners are upset.

choices.label: Find Pip, give back the charms, and say nothing.
choices.result: Pip had taken them because the lines looked lonely. You re-hang them together.
choices.consequence: Pip leaves a charm of their own on the line.

choices.label: Use Premonition to expose exactly who is taking them.
choices.result: It works. It also announces Pip's name to the crown before Pip is ready.
choices.consequence: The charms come back. Pip does not come out of the roost for days.

choices.label: Let the matter drop. Wishes belong to whoever needs them.
choices.result: The line grows a little thinner. Nobody ever finds out why.

side_quests.title: Skimmers on the Tower
side_quests.summary: A flock of veil skimmers has roosted on a Dominion survey tower and the tower's sensors are overloaded. The crew wants them gone.

choices.label: Coax the flock to a quieter bough with song and fruit.
choices.result: They follow, slowly, in a drifting veil. The tower gets its quiet.
choices.consequence: The skimmers roost on the bough. Tomas leaves them fruit on Fridays.

choices.label: Cut the roost down.
choices.result: It is done fast. The sound of the flock leaving is not something you will forget.
choices.consequence: The tower is quiet, and so is that part of the sky.

choices.label: Convince the crew to move the tower instead.
choices.result: It costs them a week. They grumble. The skimmers stay.
choices.consequence: The tower moves, and the roost stays.

side_quests.title: Under the Limb
side_quests.summary: A massive limb has fallen across a root weaver nest in the twilight layer. The family is alive under it. The limb is still moving.

choices.label: Plan the rescue: exits, timing, order of extraction.
choices.result: It takes ten minutes of careful talk. It saves everyone.
choices.consequence: The family is out, and the limb settles an hour later.

choices.label: Hop down and pull them out yourself, right now.
choices.result: You make it. Two of them make it. It was closer than you will say.
choices.consequence: The rescue is celebrated, though it should not have been needed.

choices.label: Improvise a rope bridge with the nest's own silk.
choices.result: It is ugly and it works. The weavers are impressed in spite of themselves.
choices.consequence: The silk bridge stays up for years, and the family names it after you.

secrets.name: The Silent Crown
secrets.hint: One bough where every Premonition ghost goes blank.
secrets.how_found: Climb to the uppermost crown after the Long Bough migrates and use Premonition on the empty branch.
secrets.reward: A place Cigarra cannot see, wrapped in old charms. It is quiet, and she hates it, and she cannot stop looking.

secrets.name: The Glow-Fungus Archive
secrets.hint: A wall of fungus that spells old routes when the lamps are dimmed.
secrets.how_found: Dim the lamps in the lowest hall of the deep layer and read the pattern left by the shelf-keepers.
secrets.reward: Hundreds of dead bridge routes, each marked with a name. One leads to a chamber nobody has visited.

landmarks.name: Maren's Bridge
landmarks.desc: A bridge trained by four generations of Quills. It sways like it is thinking.

landmarks.name: The Lantern Hall
landmarks.desc: A deep hall lit by terraced glow-fungus shelves tended by shelf-keepers.

landmarks.name: The Charm Line
landmarks.desc: A line of wishes strung across the crown.

landmarks.name: Survey Tower Nine
landmarks.desc: A Dominion tower the Fold has quietly adopted as a perch.

landmarks.name: Calder's Camp
landmarks.desc: Cable spools, tarps and a very tidy kettle.

landmarks.name: The Fallen Limb
landmarks.desc: A broad limb that came down in the last storm and nobody has dared to cut.

landmarks.name: The Listening House
landmarks.desc: A hall where elders read the Fold's creaking and whisper decisions.

npcs.name: Ottoline Marr
npcs.behavior: Counts glowing shelves aloud and corrects anyone who miscounts.
npcs.schedule: always in the hall, always counting

reacts.line: You were right, which is rude.

npcs.name: Old Maren Quill
npcs.behavior: Whispers to the bridge in a private language and refuses to translate.
npcs.schedule: dawn and dusk on the bridge

reacts.line: It is not on any map. Good.

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.behavior: Hangs upside down from the charm line, adding and removing tiny wishes.

reacts.line: I left you one. Do not read it yet.

creature_behaviors.behavior: Drift in veils that open as a flock turns, and close again when a predator passes below.
Pause mid-weave when a bridge creaks, as if listening for a verdict.
Follow the nearest bridge dying, and leave it a moment before it goes.

weather: night wind that sets the bridges singing
sounds: a sigh from a bridge settling

music_slots.notes: Glass harmonica over plucked fiber; slightly too busy, like an overactive mind.
Bowed wood and breath whistle, long rests between phrases.
Ghosted copy of the current cue, delayed and pitched down a third.
Rhythm in odd meters that never resolves to the downbeat.
Everything drops out except one held note. The music pretends not to notice.
Full ensemble swelling, then a sudden unison on a single pitch.
